## Sweeps

A sweep that reads one corpus stage cannot report on a page held in
another. Seven of these were blind to 53-62 until 2026-08-11.

A finding is **open** when it maps to no ruling. It is
**adjudicated** when it sits at a site John has ruled — a `preserve`
keeps what Bonitz printed, so the sweep goes on disagreeing with its
authority and the finding stands for good.

| sweep | checks | reads every stage | 15-117 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alphacheck` | headword order | yes | **blind** — 11 columns lost their geometry, 8 more measure none |
| `bekker` | impossible Bekker pages | yes | all 3 adjudicated |
| `family` | word vs its own headword | yes | 0 |
| `lexcheck` | words in no lexicon | yes | all 20 adjudicated |
| `quotecheck` | quotations vs the cited line | yes | **42 open** · 56 adjudicated |
| `siglum_check` | citation sigla vs Bonitz's key | yes | **stale** — report predates the corpus |
| `smyth_sweep` | 16 hard Smyth validators | yes | **stale** — report predates the corpus |
| `accent_law` | accent quantity rules | yes | **stale** — report predates the corpus |
| `accent` | accent vs the corpus | yes | **1 open** · 106 adjudicated |
| `breathing` | breathing vs the corpus | yes | **2 open** · 16 adjudicated |
| `breathing_oracle` | breathing vs LSJ and Aristotle | yes | **1 open** · 1 adjudicated |
| `diacritic_sweep` | diacritics vs LlamaParse | yes | **stale** — report predates the corpus |
| `book_review` | book letter vs Bekker span | yes | not counted |
| `ngram_check` | phrase recurrence | **no** | not counted |
